name: crypt-kit
description: Crypt Kit — a lean, spec-driven full-stack skeleton (RBAC, config-driven resources, voice agent, PDF reports) plus two apps raised from it.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:skeleton && npm run install:lab && npm run install:pantry
scripts.install:skeleton: npm install --prefix skeleton/server && npm install --prefix skeleton/client
scripts.install:lab: npm install --prefix lab-ledger/server && npm install --prefix lab-ledger/client
scripts.install:pantry: npm install --prefix pantry-ghost/server && npm install --prefix pantry-ghost/client
scripts.dev:skeleton: concurrently -n api,web "npm run dev --prefix skeleton/server" "npm run dev --prefix skeleton/client"
scripts.dev:lab: concurrently -n api,web "npm run dev --prefix lab-ledger/server" "npm run dev --prefix lab-ledger/client"
scripts.dev:pantry: concurrently -n api,web "npm run dev --prefix pantry-ghost/server" "npm run dev --prefix pantry-ghost/client"
scripts.test: npm run test:scripts && npm test --prefix skeleton/server && npm test --prefix skeleton/client && npm test --prefix lab-ledger/server && npm test --prefix lab-ledger/client && npm test --prefix pantry-ghost/server && npm test --prefix pantry-ghost/client
scripts.test:skeleton: npm test --prefix skeleton/server && npm test --prefix skeleton/client
